items.headline: Man United 1-1 Fulham: Late Cunha goal salvages point after poor display
items.summary: Manchester United drew 1-1 at Fulham despite 29 shots and 57% possession. Gary Neville criticized the performance as the worst he'd seen in nearly 50 years.

items.headline: Patrick Dorgu suffers hamstring injury during Denmark international duty
items.summary: Manchester United left-back Patrick Dorgu picked up a hamstring injury during Denmark's Nations League match, becoming latest first-team player sidelined.

items.headline: Karim Cassim joins Manchester United from Manchester City
items.summary: Midfielder Karim Cassim completed transfer from Manchester City to United on undisclosed terms, announced via official club channels.

items.headline: David Eze joins United from Manchester City youth setup
items.summary: Midfielder David Eze completed transfer from Manchester City on undisclosed terms, announced via official club channels.

items.headline: Leny Yoro receives first senior France call-up
items.summary: Manchester United defender Leny Yoro named in France senior squad, a positive development for the young centre-back.
